comment:
* Represents an IMS call external to the device.  This class is used to represent a call which
 * takes places on a secondary device associated with this one.  Originates from a Dialog Event
 * Package.
 *
 * Dialog event package information is received from the IMS framework via
 * {@link ImsExternalCallState} instances.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: mListeners
variables.comment:
* ConcurrentHashMap constructor params: 8 is initial table size, 0.9f is
     * load factor before resizing, 1 means we only expect a single thread to
     * access the map so make only a single shard

variables.name: mCallId
variables.comment: * The unqiue dialog event package specified ID associated with this external connection.

variables.name: mCall
variables.comment: * A backing call associated with this external connection.

variables.name: mOriginalAddress
variables.comment: * The original address as contained in the dialog event package.

variables.name: mIsPullable
variables.comment: * Determines if the call is pullable.

methods.name: public int getCallId()
methods.comment: * @return the unique ID of this connection from the dialog event package data.

methods.name: public void deflect(String number) throws CallStateException
public void transfer(String number, boolean isConfirmationRequired) throws CallStateException
public void consultativeTransfer(Connection other) throws CallStateException
public void pullExternalCall()
methods.comment:
* Called by a {@link android.telecom.Connection} to indicate that this call should be pulled
     * to the local device.
     *
     * Informs all listeners, in this case {@link ImsExternalCallTracker}, of the request to pull
     * the call.

methods.name: public void setActive()
methods.comment: * Sets this external call as active.

methods.name: public void setTerminated()
methods.comment: * Sets this external call as terminated.

methods.name: public void setIsPullable(boolean isPullable)
methods.comment:
* Changes whether the call can be pulled or not.
     *
     * @param isPullable {@code true} if the call can be pulled, {@code false} otherwise.

methods.name: public void setExternalConnectionAddress(Uri address)
methods.comment:
* Sets the address of this external connection.  Ensures that dialog event package SIP
     * {@link Uri}s are converted to a regular telephone number.
     *
     * @param address The address from the dialog event package.

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment:
* Build a human representation of a connection instance, suitable for debugging.
     * Don't log personal stuff unless in debug mode.
     * @return a string representing the internal state of this connection.

methodNames: public void deflect(String number) throws CallStateException
public void transfer(String number, boolean isConfirmationRequired) throws CallStateException
public void consultativeTransfer(Connection other) throws CallStateException
